businessReason: Send the invitation that lets an invited member join the tenant.

rows.logicalPrerequisiteRule: The source is the exact immutable TenantMemberInvited fact; the one delivery attempt is sent unless the invitation is proven accepted, expired, or its mailbox moved to a newer invitation, in which case the step is superseded. A resumed unknown result resends the same attempt identity.

requiredProofContract.canonicalCarrier: original admitted root reference + required independently verified typed stage/terminal proof sets
requiredProofContract.admissionReferenceRole: original business admission/first-owner fact, distinct from subscription trigger and intermediate/terminal prerequisites

verification.admission: AdmissionReference is a locator only. Resolve and independently verify actual typed admitted fact, exact owner/tenant/program, saved metadata and physical/hydrated cut, original root/episode/actor/intent and immutable content.
verification.stageAndTerminal: Materialize each required typed stage/terminal proof from actual committed facts and full required immutable selections; prove complete grant/fence/provisional/child sets, not counts/checkpoints. Guard sets are not weakened by carrier choice.
verification.earlyReplay: If native receipt binding does not cover a supplied/interpreted command term, bind that term through the required actual typed proof/body before early replay. Exact receipt cannot bypass proof manifest or source tuple guards.
verification.resultAndRecovery: Current public authorization precedes replay. Original result/receipt and unknown-append recovery stay exact; requested cancellation propagates. Unavailable proof/content remains transient; corruption/changed intent is permanent; no inferred absence/release.
verification.implementationStatus: Installed pointer/handler/process presence is not proof of conformance. Field/wire migration and required behavioral tests remain separately verifiable implementation work.

requiredTypedStageProofSets.role: Acceptance of the same invitation makes sending moot; none may exist
requiredTypedStageProofSets.requiredVerification: Resolve the actual saved fact and its full immutable selection; verify the typed payload and the exact admission, root, target, generation, actor and intent binding. A pointer, checkpoint or stage order alone is not authority.

requiredTypedStageProofSets.role: Mailbox holder is still this invitation (or empty); no newer holder
requiredTypedStageProofSets.requiredVerification: Resolve the actual saved fact and its full immutable selection; verify the typed payload and the exact admission, root, target, generation, actor and intent binding. A pointer, checkpoint or stage order alone is not authority.

requiredProofContract.pinnedSourceRequirements: Every exact source owner/event/content revision and complete immutable manifest required by intendedProofGate remains mandatory; no absent optional source is fabricated.
requiredProofContract.proofGate: Exact immutable payload of the accepted invitation fact; skipped as proven superseded once the offer is accepted, expired or its mailbox moved to a newer invitation. Sends one attempt with a stable identity; a resumed unknown result sends the same attempt again and never a new one.
requiredTechnicalProofs: actual named delivery attempt and stored relay outcome/current ledger state; typed callback bound to root and attempt
requiredProofContract.requiredLogicalPrerequisiteProofs: Every applicable logical prerequisite is independently verified as an actual typed saved fact (or actual technical proof where explicitly technical); a terminal proof may establish an earlier stage only through a verified native chain that includes that required typed stage. Stage order/checkpoint alone never substitutes.

prerequisiteVerification.admission: The receiver resolves the original admitted root fact by its exact owner, tenant, episode, actor and immutable intent, and verifies the saved fact and content hash before acting; a reference alone grants nothing.
prerequisiteVerification.stageProofs: Each required stage proof (grant, hold, review, or terminal fact) is materialised from the actual committed fact and its full immutable selection; counts, checkpoints and stage order are not accepted as proof.

requiredProofContract.stageProofRationale: Send handler computes moot reason from invitation state, clock and mailbox claim holder.

effectIdentity.existingOccupiedV1: Preserve exact source-event UUID namespace, current EffectIdentity UTF8 delimiter bytes, process/receiver text, each frozen target selector and exact episode. Retain root-derived IDs when adding required proofs; no source-event substitution or silent selector rewrite.
effectIdentity.newAlgorithmPolicy: Any new length-prefixed algorithm is explicitly versioned and uses injective field encoding with explicit process/effect/target/episode domains and compatibility/fencing. It never changes occupied v1 IDs.
effectIdentity.implementationQualification: Selected policy only; individual new algorithm/wire implementation must prove exact vectors and domain/compatibility fences before emission.

fieldsInOrder: episode (exact selected value, initial when absent)
newArtifactAlgorithm.bytes: UTF8(effect-identity:v2) followed by each field UTF8 bytes prefixed by its unsigned32-bit big-endian byte length; UUIDv5 over these exact name bytes and the actual source EventId namespace.
newArtifactAlgorithm.rule: Use only for this new unoccupied process identity domain; occupied v1 algorithms/target-key selections remain unchanged. Implementation must provide fixed byte/UUID vectors before activation.

recoveryContract.lostAcknowledgement: If the receiver's append succeeded but the acknowledgement was lost, redelivery resolves the same deterministic effect identity and returns the original committed result without a second append.
recoveryContract.retryAfterPartialProgress: A retry re-reads the target stream; a proven superseded or already-applied operation is a terminal no-op; an unavailable dependency or unknown append outcome is transient and retried; changed intent or an invalid proof is a permanent conflict and the operation is quarantined.
recoveryContract.concurrencyConflict: On an optimistic-concurrency conflict at the target the receiver re-reads and re-decides under the target's current state; it never overwrites a newer decision.
recoveryContract.abortOfAdmittedRoot: If the admitted root is cancelled or the process is aborted, the bound abort receiver fences the target so a delayed delivery cannot apply, and any held reservation is released only after the fence is durable.
